#Problem 1

```{r}
library(readxl)

# Read annual PC1 volatility
PC1_annual <- read_excel(
  "Zero_Coupon_1961_PC_Volatility.xlsx",
  sheet = "PC1 Annual"
)

# Keep 1962-2025
PC1_annual <- PC1_annual[
  PC1_annual$Year >= 1962 & PC1_annual$Year <= 2025,
]

# Annual PC1 volatility from log zero-coupon rates
V <- PC1_annual$`PC1 Log Volatility`

# Take natural log
ln_V <- log(V)

# Put together
Vt <- data.frame(
  Year = PC1_annual$Year,
  V = V,
  ln_V = ln_V
)

# Fitting AR(1) model
AR1 <- arima(
  Vt$ln_V,
  order = c(1, 0, 0)
)

AR1
# Innovations Z(t)
Zt <- residuals(AR1)
# ACF of Z(t)
acf(Zt, main = "ACF of Z(t)")
# ACF of absolute Z(t)
acf(abs(Zt), main = "ACF of |Z(t)|")
# QQ plot of Z(t)
qqnorm(Zt, main = "QQ Plot of Z(t)")
qqline(Zt)
# Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
shapiro.test(Zt)
# Jarque-Bera test
library(tseries)
jarque.bera.test(Zt)

# Ljung-Box test for Z(t) at lag 5
Box.test(Zt, lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box test for Z(t) at lag 10
Box.test(Zt, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box test for |Z(t)| at lag 5
Box.test(abs(Zt), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box test for |Z(t)| at lag 10
Box.test(abs(Zt), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
```


#PROBLEM 2
```{r}
SP_data <- read_excel(
  "full-data.xlsx",
  sheet = "data"
)


SP_data <- SP_data[SP_data$Year >= 1962, ]

# S&P volatility
SP_Vt <- SP_data$Volatility

# Take log of S&P volatility
SP_Vt <- log(SP_Vt)
# Putting S&P volatility with Year
SP <- data.frame(
  Year = SP_data$Year,
  SP_Vt = SP_Vt
)

# Combineing bond and S&P volatility
VAR_data <- merge(
  Vt[, c("Year", "ln_V")],
  SP,
  by = "Year"
)

head(VAR_data)

library(vars)

# Fit VAR(1)
VAR1 <- VAR(
  VAR_data[, c("ln_V", "SP_Vt")],
  p = 1,
  type = "const"
)

summary(VAR1)

#innovations
Z <- residuals(VAR1)

# Bond innovations
Z1 <- Z[, "ln_V"]

# S&P innovations
Z2 <- Z[, "SP_Vt"]
# ACF of bond innovations
acf(Z1, main = "ACF of Z1")

# ACF of absolute bond innovations
acf(abs(Z1), main = "ACF of |Z1|")

# ACF of S&P innovations
acf(Z2, main = "ACF of Z2")

# ACF of absolute S&P innovations
acf(abs(Z2), main = "ACF of |Z2|")
# QQ plot for bond innovations
qqnorm(Z1, main = "QQ Plot of Z1")
qqline(Z1)

# QQ plot for S&P innovations
qqnorm(Z2, main = "QQ Plot of Z2")
qqline(Z2)
# Shapiro-Wilk tests
shapiro.test(Z1)
shapiro.test(Z2)
# Jarque-Bera tests
library(tseries)

jarque.bera.test(Z1)
jarque.bera.test(Z2)

# Ljung-Box tests for Z1
Box.test(Z1, lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(Z1, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box tests for |Z1|
Box.test(abs(Z1), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(abs(Z1), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box tests for Z2
Box.test(Z2, lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(Z2, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box tests for |Z2|
Box.test(abs(Z2), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(abs(Z2), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
```


#PROBLEM 3
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

# Read zero-coupon data
ZC <- read_excel("zero-coupon-1961.xlsx")

# Convert Date
ZC$Date <- as.Date(ZC$Date)

# Create Year
ZC$Year <- format(ZC$Date, "%Y")

# Convert 6Y and 7Y rates to numeric
ZC$`6Y` <- as.numeric(na_if(ZC$`6Y`, "NA"))
ZC$`7Y` <- as.numeric(na_if(ZC$`7Y`, "NA"))

# Keep the last observation of each year
ZC_annual <- ZC %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  slice_max(Date, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Convert rates from percent to decimal
R6 <- ZC_annual$`6Y` / 100
R7 <- ZC_annual$`7Y` / 100

# Annual log return of the 7-year zero-coupon bond
Bond_Return <- 7 * R7[-length(R7)] - 6 * R6[-1]

# Put together
Bond_Returns <- data.frame(
  Year = ZC_annual$Year[-1],
  Log_Return = Bond_Return
)

head(Bond_Returns)
```
#4

```{r}


Rt <- data.frame(
  Year = ZC_annual$Year,
  R = ZC_annual$`7Y` / 100
)


Rt <- Rt[
  Rt$Year >= 1962 & Rt$Year <= 2025,
]

head(Rt)

R_current <- Rt$R[-1]
R_lag <- Rt$R[-length(Rt$R)]

# Fitting AR(1)
AR1_R <- lm(R_current ~ R_lag)


summary(AR1_R)


Z_R <- residuals(AR1_R)
Z_R <- residuals(AR1_R)

# ACF of residuals
acf(Z_R, main = "ACF of Z")

# ACF of absolute residuals
acf(abs(Z_R), main = "ACF of |Z|")

# QQ plot
qqnorm(Z_R, main = "QQ Plot of Z")
qqline(Z_R)

# Shapiro-Wilk normality test
shapiro.test(Z_R)

# Jarque-Bera normality test
library(tseries)
jarque.bera.test(Z_R)

# Ljung-Box tests for residuals
Box.test(Z_R, lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(Z_R, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box tests for absolute residuals
Box.test(abs(Z_R), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(abs(Z_R), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
```

#Problem 5
```{r}
# Merging 7Y rate with PC1 bond volatility by year
P5 <- merge(
  Rt[, c("Year", "R")],
  Vt[, c("Year", "V")],
  by = "Year"
)

P5$Year <- as.numeric(P5$Year)

# Creating lagged R using the actual previous year
P5_lag <- P5[, c("Year", "R")]
P5_lag$Year <- P5_lag$Year + 1
names(P5_lag)[2] <- "R_lag"

# Adding the correct one-year lag
P5 <- merge(
  P5[, c("Year", "R", "V")],
  P5_lag,
  by = "Year",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# Checking 1990-1994
P5[P5$Year >= 1990 & P5$Year <= 1994, ]

# Creating transformed variables
P5$R_over_V <- P5$R / P5$V
P5$one_over_V <- 1 / P5$V
P5$Rlag_over_V <- P5$R_lag / P5$V

# Fit the model
Model5 <- lm(
  R_over_V ~ one_over_V + Rlag_over_V,
  data = P5
)

summary(Model5)

# Getting W(t)
Wt <- residuals(Model5)

# ACF of W(t)
acf(Wt, main = "ACF of W")

# ACF of absolute W(t)
acf(abs(Wt), main = "ACF of |W|")
# QQ plot of W(t)
qqnorm(Wt, main = "QQ Plot of W")
qqline(Wt)

# Shapiro-Wilk normality test
shapiro.test(Wt)

# Jarque-Bera normality test
library(tseries)
jarque.bera.test(Wt)

# Ljung-Box tests for W(t)
Box.test(Wt, lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(Wt, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box tests for absolute W(t)
Box.test(abs(Wt), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(abs(Wt), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
```

#PROBLEM 6
```{r}
# Creating log rates
P5$ln_R <- log(P5$R)
P5$ln_R_lag <- log(P5$R_lag)


head(P5[, c("Year", "ln_R", "V", "ln_R_lag")])

# Creating transformed variables for Problem 6
P5$lnR_over_V <- P5$ln_R / P5$V
P5$lnRlag_over_V <- P5$ln_R_lag / P5$V

# model
Model6 <- lm(
  lnR_over_V ~ one_over_V + lnRlag_over_V,
  data = P5
)


summary(Model6)

# W(t) residuals
W6 <- residuals(Model6)

# ACF of W(t)
acf(W6, main = "ACF of W - Problem 6")

# ACF of absolute W(t)
acf(abs(W6), main = "ACF of |W| - Problem 6")

# QQ plot of W(t)
qqnorm(W6, main = "QQ Plot of W - Problem 6")
qqline(W6)

# Shapiro-Wilk normality test
shapiro.test(W6)

# Jarque-Bera normality test
library(tseries)
jarque.bera.test(W6)

# Ljung-Box tests for W(t)
Box.test(W6, lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(W6, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box tests for absolute W(t)
Box.test(abs(W6), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(abs(W6), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
```



#Trying to make 1 and 2 IID Gaussian byh Yeo Johnson trnasform
```{r}
library(bestNormalize)
YJ1 <- yeojohnson(Vt$ln_V)

YJ1

Vt$YJ_ln_V <- predict(YJ1)

head(Vt[, c("Year", "ln_V", "YJ_ln_V")])

# AR(1) after Yeo-Johnson transformation
AR1_YJ <- arima(
  Vt$YJ_ln_V,
  order = c(1, 0, 0)
)

AR1_YJ

# Residuals from Yeo-Johnson AR(1)
Z_YJ1 <- residuals(AR1_YJ)


# ACF of residuals
acf(Z_YJ1, main = "ACF of Z - Yeo-Johnson Problem 1")

# ACF of absolute residuals
acf(abs(Z_YJ1), main = "ACF of |Z| - Yeo-Johnson Problem 1")


qqnorm(Z_YJ1, main = "QQ Plot of Z - Yeo-Johnson Problem 1")
qqline(Z_YJ1)


# Shapiro-Wilk test
shapiro.test(Z_YJ1)

# Jarque-Bera test
library(tseries)
jarque.bera.test(Z_YJ1)


# Residuals
Box.test(Z_YJ1, lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(Z_YJ1, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Absolute residuals
Box.test(abs(Z_YJ1), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(abs(Z_YJ1), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
```

#For Probelm 2 Applying Yeo Johnson transformation to it
```{r}

library(bestNormalize)
library(vars)
library(tseries)



# Bond log volatility
YJ_Bond <- yeojohnson(VAR_data$ln_V)

# S&P log volatility
YJ_SP <- yeojohnson(VAR_data$SP_Vt)

# estimated lambdas
YJ_Bond
YJ_SP


#Creating trnasformed variables
VAR_data$YJ_Bond <- predict(YJ_Bond)
VAR_data$YJ_SP <- predict(YJ_SP)


head(
  VAR_data[, c("Year", "ln_V", "YJ_Bond", "SP_Vt", "YJ_SP")]
)


# 3. Fitting VAR(1) using Yeo-Johnson transformed variables
VAR_YJ <- VAR(
  VAR_data[, c("YJ_Bond", "YJ_SP")],
  p = 1,
  type = "const"
)

summary(VAR_YJ)


# 4. new residuals

Z_YJ <- residuals(VAR_YJ)

# Bond innovation
Z1_YJ <- Z_YJ[, "YJ_Bond"]

# S&P innovation
Z2_YJ <- Z_YJ[, "YJ_SP"]


# ACF of Z1
acf(
  Z1_YJ,
  main = "ACF of Z1 - Yeo-Johnson Problem 2"
)

# ACF of absolute Z1
acf(
  abs(Z1_YJ),
  main = "ACF of |Z1| - Yeo-Johnson Problem 2"
)

# QQ plot
qqnorm(
  Z1_YJ,
  main = "QQ Plot of Z1 - Yeo-Johnson Problem 2"
)
qqline(Z1_YJ)

# Normality tests
shapiro.test(Z1_YJ)
jarque.bera.test(Z1_YJ)

# Ljung-Box tests for Z1
Box.test(Z1_YJ, lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(Z1_YJ, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box tests for absolute Z1
Box.test(abs(Z1_YJ), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(abs(Z1_YJ), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")


# ACF of Z2
acf(
  Z2_YJ,
  main = "ACF of Z2 - Yeo-Johnson Problem 2"
)

# ACF of absolute Z2
acf(
  abs(Z2_YJ),
  main = "ACF of |Z2| - Yeo-Johnson Problem 2"
)

# QQ plot
qqnorm(
  Z2_YJ,
  main = "QQ Plot of Z2 - Yeo-Johnson Problem 2"
)
qqline(Z2_YJ)

# Normality tests
shapiro.test(Z2_YJ)
jarque.bera.test(Z2_YJ)

# Ljung-Box tests for Z2
Box.test(Z2_YJ, lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(Z2_YJ, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box tests for absolute Z2
Box.test(abs(Z2_YJ), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(abs(Z2_YJ), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
```
